## About

Hey 👋 I’m Alex. I like the early stages; no playbook, just a vision and a lot to figure out. I’m a marketer by title but a builder at heart. I've worked across product, strategy, and analytics to architect GTM motions that actually work. That usually means finding the story that resonates, turning it into programs that drive traction, and leveraging data to stay focused on what matters. Most of my experience is in cybersecurity, helping startups grow from $0 to over $100M in ARR. I’ve done the work—positioning, launches, demand, partnerships, analyst relations. But, my alpha is bringing clarity in the chaos, and creating momentum where there was none.

Total Experience: 10 years and 1 month

We’re building a task force of intelligent agents to tackle persistent problems like asset inventory, vulnerability prioritization, remediation, and mitigation.

# Cogent's Head of Growth, Alexander Semien, breaks down the diverging narrative of AI-in-cybersecurity across two of the frontier labs. | Cogent · LinkedIn · 2026-05-13

**Cogent**: Cogent has 40-50 employees, founded in 2024. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India. Has $53M in total funding, with 2 prior funding rounds.

---

[Cogent](https://linkedin.com/company/cogentsecurity)'s Head of Growth, [Alexander Semien](https://linkedin.com/in/alexander-semien), breaks down the diverging narrative of AI-in-cybersecurity across two of the frontier labs.

Yesterday's announcement from [OpenAI](https://linkedin.com/company/openai) positioned Daybreak as a defensive partnership story with legacy cybersecurity companies. [Anthropic](https://linkedin.com/company/anthropicresearch)'s Mythos, however, landed as offensive proof of maturing models - with early access given exclusively to mega-enterprises.

Both rest on the same underlying capabilities, and both stop short of the actual hard part: turning findings into fixes, on the time scale modern adversaries operate on.

Check out the original post and comments for the link!

# I'm back with another role! This time for Revenue Operations. | Alexander Semien · LinkedIn · 2026-05-02

**Alexander Semien**: Marketing at Cogent Security for 1 year with 10 years of total professional experience. Previous roles include VP, Product Marketing at Sevco Security, Director, Strategy & Analytics at Abnormal Security, and Manager, Finance & Operations at Zyper (Acquired by Discord). Based in New York, New York, United States [US].

---

I'm back with another role! This time for Revenue Operations.

Some of the best GTM operators I've worked with came up in banking or consulting and pivoted to tech. They think in models, conversion math, and frameworks. They understand that growth is an equation to be understood and optimized, not just gut feeling.

At Cogent, we built the entire growth function on a custom in-house AI operating system. Every decision we make is rooted in data. We already have the automation and agents. Now we need the human to interpret what they're showing, find the so what, and drive the change across the sales org.

If you're nerdy like me and like using math every day, this might be the job for you! JD in the comments. 😊
